svg.title: Aether — Genesis, Ouroboros, Yggdrasil
svg.desc: Symbolic Aether identities: Genesis, Ouroboros and the accepted living Yggdrasil world-tree. All three directions are planned, not built. Celestial framing is brand art, not a scientific diagram or implementation promise. Product names and scope are provided in adjacent accessible native text. Concise product-name labels identify each symbol; descriptions, links and release statuses remain accessible native text.
